[LIMP.12.3] **A built-in schema's name is taken in every file.** An author must
not declare a schema under a name [LIMP.12.2] lists, and the compiler must
refuse such a declaration: with `DS_VALIDATE_RESERVED_TYPE_NAME` for
`ComputationError` and `TypeError`, whose names are reserved words
([LERR.9.4]), and with `DS_VALIDATE_IMPORT_NAME_COLLISION` ([LIMP.2.1.7]) for
the others. No alias resolves the collision, because nothing names the module
([LIMP.12.1]).

A built-in schema is therefore the same in every program. No program declares
its own `CallError`, so none changes its lifetime ([LCRS.6.6.1]).
